request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colour of the metal: the grey helmet and the grey round shield become dark tarnished bronze with a dull rusted iron rim, shaded dark brown. Do not touch the skull, the eyes, the bones, the black crest, the loincloth or the sword. Keep everything else exactly the same: the pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
